head: Paperknife PDF app for Android wins reader poll: free and offline
dek: Paperknife Plus, a free PDF toolkit that works without internet or an account, came first in Android Authority's reader poll for the new Android app of 2026, with 161 of 1,460 votes (11%) by 23 November.
details: No app won a clear lead: Vela Maps came second with 8.9% and AI Hub third with 8.7%. Paperknife Plus has 21 tools, among them merge, split, rotate, sign, watermark, compress, password lock and converting PDFs to and from images or text. It's open source (GPL-3.0), has no ads and asks for no internet permission. It needs Android 7.0 or later and is about 8 MB.
where: Android 7.0 and later, from GitHub, F-Droid and IzzyOnDroid (no public Play Store release yet)
means: If you edit PDFs on your phone and don't want to upload them to a website, this app does the common jobs on the device itself.
todo: Get it from the project's GitHub releases page or F-Droid; it isn't in the Play Store yet.
thumb_words: FREE OFFLINE PDF APP WINS POLL
